description: This file defines the static class ReferenceCodec that provides methods for serializing and deserializing object references within the Orleans serialization framework. It includes methods for writing references, reading references, handling null references, and tracking object references during serialization/deserialization sessions.

methods.name: MarkValueField
methods.description: Marks the current field as a value field in the serialization session to handle object references correctly.

methods.name: TryWriteReferenceFieldExpected
methods.description: Attempts to write a reference for a value type when the reference is already known, with an expected buffer writer type, and if not, returns false.

methods.name: TryWriteReferenceField
methods.description: Attempts to write an object reference if the object has been previously seen, including its type information.

methods.name: TryWriteReferenceField (overload)
methods.description: Attempts to write an object reference with explicit actual and expected type information, allowing derived or fixed types to be properly referenced.

methods.name: WriteNullReference
methods.description: Writes a null object reference to the output, marking the value as null.

methods.name: ReadReference
methods.description: Reads a reference from the input, returning the object if the reference exists, or null if zero.

methods.name: DeserializeFromMarker
methods.description: Deserializes an object that was referenced via a marker, replacing the placeholder in the session with the actual object.

methods.name: RecordObject (session, value)
methods.description: Records an object in the serialization session as referenced.

methods.name: RecordObject (session, value, referenceId)
methods.description: Records an object with a specific reference ID in the serialization session.

methods.name: CreateRecordPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates and returns a placeholder reference ID for objects that are not immediately deserialized.
